**Вищий ступінь** (+ than) · **найвищий*:
**Comparative** (+ than) · **superlative** (the …):
- 1 syllable: **-er / the -est** — *cheap → cheaper → the cheapest*
- ending in -e: *nice → nicer → the nicest*
- double the last letter after a short vowel: *big → bigger, hot → the hottest*
- ending in -y: **-ier / -iest** — *easy → easier → the easiest*
- 2+ syllables: **more / the most** — *more expensive → the most expensive*
- irregular: *good → better → the best · bad → worse → the worst · far → further → the furthest*

**as + adjective + as** — the same · **not as … as** — less
To make it stronger: **much / a lot / far** + comparative; a little — **a bit**
The more…, the better… — «чим більше…, т: The more…, the better… — one thing grows together with the other (also The longer…).
as … as — рівні; not as … as — «не такий: as … as — equal; not as … as — “less … than”.
better уже вищий ступінь — more зайве. М: better is already a comparative — more is extra. Remove it or make it stronger: much / a lot / far better.
good → better → the best — неправильні ф: good → better → the best — irregular forms.
much / a lot / far — набагато; a bit — т: much / a lot / far — by a lot; a bit — a little.
the + -est / the most — one out of all.
Вищий ступінь + than: що з двох більше,: Comparative + than: which of two is bigger, better.
Короткий прикметник — -est, з подвоєнням: Short adjective — -est, with a double letter: big → biggest.
Моя нова робота не така напружена, як ст: My new job is less stressful than my old one.
Один склад або два з -y — закінчення -er: One syllable, or two ending in -y — the -er ending.
Перед вищим ступенем — much / a lot / fa: Before a comparative — much / a lot / far, not very.
We compare with than, not that.
Потяг до Києва набагато швидший за автоб: The train to Kyiv is a lot faster than the bus.
Ступені порівняння допомагають вибирати: Comparatives and superlatives help you choose and explain a difference: cheaper, more comfortable, “the same as”. You need them in a shop, when travelling, when giving advice: *The train is faster than the bus.*
